newsitem.title: SWEDEN: P&U to market lab. products with Oncotech.
newsitem.headline: P&U to market lab. products with Oncotech.

text.p: U.S./Swedish drugs company Pharmacia & Upjohn on Monday said it was to start marketing oncology laboratory equipment in North America with Oncotech, a company involved in cancer treatment in California.
Pharmacia & Upjohn will pay Oncotech $5.5 million for its part of marketing rights in North America and for an option that extends its rights to other markets, the company said in a release.
Pharmacia & Upjohn will also support future clinical trials with Oncotech's prognosis tests and analysis of extreme drug resistance (EDR).
EDR analysis measures drug resistance in individual tumours.

The company said clinical trials have showed that EDR analysis is very exact when it comes to forecasting clinical failures with chemotherapy when a patient's tumour has extreme drug resistance against treatment.
Oncotech will service more than 1,200 oncologists and more than 750 hospitals in the U.S. during 1996, the company said.
